What is Visily?

Wireframing and prototyping tool built explicitly for non-designers, with AI generation from text, screenshots and sketches, and a deliberately simple interface. Notable for a genuinely generous free tier.

Best for

Fast, low-commitment wireframing by non-designers with a strong free tier.

Main features

  • Text-to-design AI generating screens from a prompt
  • Screenshot-to-Design converting any app screenshot into an editable wireframe
  • Sketch-to-Design from hand drawings
  • Diagram AI for flowcharts and user journeys
  • large template and UI kit library
  • low-fidelity to high-fidelity switching with one click
  • interactive prototyping
  • real-time collaboration with comments
  • Figma export
  • AI Themes.

Practical use cases

  • Wireframing a feature for a requirements document
  • converting a competitor's screen into a starting wireframe
  • producing user flow diagrams
  • running a stakeholder workshop with editable screens
  • teaching UI concepts.

Who is it for?

  • Product managers, business analysts, founders, consultants, engineers and educators - explicitly targeting people who are not designers.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium per-editor subscription

Plans described in the source

Free $0 with unlimited projects and editors on personal workspaces, generous AI generation limits and no watermark - notably more generous than Uizard's free tier. Professional around $12-19/editor/mo billed annually with team workspaces, advanced AI, version history and unlimited AI generations. Enterprise custom with SSO, admin controls and dedicated support. Annual billing discounted.

Free plan

Yes - one of the most generous free tiers in the design category, with unlimited projects and no watermark.

Free trial

Yes - Professional trials offered; the free tier is substantial enough for real work.

Usage limits to consider

Free tier caps AI generations per month and limits team workspace features and version history, but places no hard limit on projects. Editor seats are charged; viewers are free.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The free tier is genuinely usable for real work with no watermark, which is rare and makes Visily the lowest-risk option here
  • screenshot-to-design is fast and accurate
  • Diagram AI covering flowcharts as well as screens is a useful breadth advantage over Uizard
  • deliberately simple, so non-designers are productive within minutes.

Limitations to consider

  • Less capable than Uizard's Autodesigner for generating complete multi-screen apps from a prompt
  • wireframe-oriented, so high-fidelity visual design is weaker
  • smaller company with less funding and a shorter track record
  • no API
  • component and design-system capabilities are thin
  • not a Figma replacement in any respect.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web
  • Figma export
  • desktop app

Languages

  • English interface; designs in any language

API access

No public API

Integrations and exports

  • Figma export, Jira, Confluence, Google Drive, PNG/PDF export, embed in Notion

Evaluation notes

Visily is the better first trial than Uizard purely because the free tier lets you evaluate on real work without paying. If your need is polished high-fidelity output rather than wireframes, neither tool is the right answer - use Figma.
